Profiles for the account-timeline tests, in the formats the platforms' APIs return: GitHub users API (`octocat` is GitHub's own public example account), X/Twitter API v2 user lookup, Reddit `about.json`, Mastodon account, and the text of a profile page. The other accounts are made up; `github-kit-before.json` and `github-kit-after.json` are one account (same number) under two names.
